verdict.rationale: Segment's own sources catalog lists a third-party cloud-app source (Shopify), and the docs claim it can capture data from any source, so ingesting from external apps is a real product capability. The evidence is thin: one catalog entry, partner-built, plus marketing copy. Source Functions let users write JavaScript to bring in new data types, but that is a developer building block, not a ready-made cloud-source integration. Missing for 10: documentation of the cloud-app source catalog's breadth, how cloud sources sync (schedule/frequency, objects pulled), first-party (non-partner) cloud source examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can pull customer data in from third-party cloud apps and feeds — not just my own instrumented apps

citations.quote: Capture data from any source, enforce quality with schemas, unify customer identity, and send it to hundreds of tools
Functions let you create your own sources and destinations directly within your workspace to bring new types of data into Segment
